430fbcc4.title: A Heteroscedastic Physics-Informed Deep Architecture for Stochastic Incompressible Flow Field Reconstruction and Uncertainty Quantification: A
430fbcc4.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have gained significant attention as a mesh-free approach for reconstructing flow fields by combining governing partial differential equations with sparse observational data. However, most existing PINN frameworks are deterministic and do not provide information about the uncertainty associated with their predictions. In this study, we present a controlled multi-seed comparison of three PINN variants for reconstructing a two-dimensional incompressible flow field: a Standard PINN, an MC Dropout PINN that estimates epistemic uncertainty through stochastic forward passes, and a Split-Head Uncertainty-Quantifying PINN (UQ-PINN).
